observation: known base/goal relative coordinates + ideal odometry + local raycast voxel projection; no global map or gate labels
reward: delivered fixed value / 4: near=0.25, far=1; timeout/fall=0; one delivery per episode
cargo: Known fixed values 1 and 4; identical unloaded dynamics; logical loading; higher-value contact upgrades cargo, never downgrades it
trial: two independent Bernoulli gates sampled once; unchanged over 3 episodes; deadline fixed within trial
backend: Genesis 0.4.6 + frozen Full_8000 unloaded locomotion + first-hit lidar
reset: step ends an episode; next_episode keeps hidden gates; reset starts a new trial
step_unit: high-level decisions at 2 Hz; frozen locomotion at 50 Hz

bc_schedule.sampling: s is the active transition count at rollout start; one beta per PPO update
bc_schedule.step_count: summed active high-level transitions across all parallel trials; excludes demonstrations, BC replay, evaluation, and inactive physics
bc_schedule.loss: PPO loss + beta * BC action MSE; PPO coefficient remains 1
bc_schedule.meaning: BC loss coefficient decays during PPO; optimizer parameters are not decayed

test_protocol: all four seen gate patterns at all three deadlines; validation initial seeds 300000+, final evaluation seeds 400000+; feasibility only
